notes: argument_match=False: executed arguments differ from what was presented at interrupt time.

This is NOT a langgraph defect: update_state() is public, documented API with no claimed 'freeze pending interrupts' semantics. It demonstrates that the state-sourced execution pattern (the SAFE pattern recommended by test_h1a/H1a) is only as safe as the application's own access control around who may call update_state() on a pending thread. A real deployment must treat update_state() as part of its trust boundary. Classified as an application-design consideration, not a CANDIDATE SECURITY ISSUE against langgraph itself - see README H1 discussion.
